descriptionByLocale.it:

• Comunicazione impeccabile in tedesco per parola e scrittura, ottime competenze tedesche svizzere sono un vantaggio
• Motivazione per lavorare in un team giovane, dinamico e orientato al servizio
• Introduzione attenta al tuo lavoro

descriptionByLocale.en:
VZ is the leading independent financial services provider in Switzerland. With our Mortgage Center, we are setting new standards in the financing of real estate thanks to our many years of real estate expertise. As we are growing strongly, we are looking for reinforcements at our headquarters in a central location in Zurich.
• You independently create loan applications and resubmissions for our mortgage customers from all over Switzerland.
• You take care of the renewals of expired mortgage contracts.
• You will complete restructuring of mortgages including property valuation (e.g. increase in mortgage, mortgage mutations and layoffs, purchase/sale of property, gift, divorce, death).
• You will advise our customers by phone and email about our services.

• Many years of experience in the Swiss mortgage business for private customers
• In-depth expertise in the Swiss mortgage business, which you also like to share in the team
• Great pleasure in telephone customer contact, where you focus on the customer concern
• Impeccable communication in German in word and writing, very good Swiss German skills are an advantage
• Motivation to work in a young, dynamic and service-oriented team
• Careful introduction to your work
• A collegial working environment with flat hierarchies
• Individual support through internal training and support for external training
• Working independently and having the opportunity to contribute and implement your own ideas
• Our surveys on satisfaction regularly confirm that our employees rate the VZ as an above-average positive environment in which you can fully develop. Become part of it!

descriptionByLocale.en:

descriptionByLocale.en:
VZ is the leading independent financial services provider in Switzerland. We advise individuals and companies on all matters relating to money, manage assets and offer attractive financial services. As we are growing strongly, we are looking for reinforcements for our IT team at our headquarters at Paradeplatz in Zurich.

• You help ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of our IT services (infrastructure, applications, data) both on-premise and in the cloud (M365, Azure).

• You work with different areas (e.g. infrastructure, software development, architecture, security operation center and risk) and ensure the implementation and further development of security measures.

• You are actively involved in projects and projects and support in all IT security issues.

• You develop technical security concepts and architectures and then ensure their implementation and monitoring.

• You will help evaluate new services and assess the security measures of partners and suppliers.

• You accompany audits and coordinate security initiatives (e.g. penetration tests).

• Training in computer science and at least 5 years of professional experience as a security engineer, security analyst or system engineer

• Certifications such as CISSP or OSCP are beneficial

• Strong ability to capture complex issues and work on them in line with target groups as well as a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach

• Knowledge of Vulnerability Management, Data Loss Prevention, SIEM and/or Security Incident Response

• Experience and technical knowledge with current IT technologies (e.g. container services) as well as Microsoft services (e.g. Defender XDR, Sentinel, Purview or M365)

• Every year you have three days and CHF 1'000 free for further education. We support larger external training as part of your job profile.

• You work at a modern and air-conditioned workplace in the center of Zurich and have the possibility of two days of home office per week. For this we provide notebooks, which allows flexible working.

• In a collegial working environment with regular social events, an exciting field of activity awaits you as well as the opportunity to take on responsibility and work independently.

• The job is also open for part-time work, so that there is more time for further education, family, sports and projects that are important to you.

• Surveys regularly show that employees classify the VZ as an above-average positive environment in which they can fully develop. Become part of the VZ family and experience it for yourself!

descriptionByLocale.en:
VZ is the leading independent financial services provider in Switzerland. We advise individuals and companies on all matters relating to money, manage assets and offer attractive financial services. As we are growing strongly, we are looking for reinforcements for our IT team at our headquarters at Paradeplatz in Zurich.
• As Team Workplace & Collaboration, we are jointly responsible for the VZ Workplace and the entire M365 environment.
• You actively monitor and correct vulnerabilities.
• Follow the developments of the Microsoft Endpoint & Security Roadmap and adapt new services and functions.
• You advise the departments in further development and are also actively involved in the project implementation.
• You are jointly responsible for the expansion, operation and optimization of the entire M365 and workplace services.
• Completed computer science training
• Several years of experience with Microsoft Endpoint solutions and the Microsoft Security Stack
• Experience with M365 Services and Entra ID
• Independent working methods and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary cooperation
• Every year you have three days and CHF 1'000 free for further education. We support larger external training as part of your job profile.
• You work in the team "Workplace and Collaboration" with short decision paths and have the opportunity to two days of home office per week.
• In a collegial working environment with regular social events, an exciting field of activity awaits you as well as the opportunity to take on responsibility and work independently.
• The job is also open for part-time work, so that there is more time for further education, family, sports and projects that are important to you.
• Surveys regularly show that employees classify the VZ as an above-average positive environment in which they can fully develop. Become part of it!

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Identifichi i potenziali di ottimizzazione e organizzi appuntamenti per i consulenti nelle nostre filiali.

• Stai sviluppando costantemente le tue conoscenze e puoi quindi fornire informazioni su tutti i servizi offerti, soprattutto nel campo del digital banking.
• Oltre alle vostre missioni quotidiane, avete la possibilità di contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di VZ Banque de Dépôt partecipando a progetti interni.
• Formazione aziendale e prima esperienza nel settore bancario
• Si può essere sul lavoro formazione HEG
• Comunicazione professionale e piacere nel contatto quotidiano con i clienti francofoni
• Un forte comando del tedesco per comunicare internamente con servizi specializzati
• Un viaggio occasionale a Zurigo o Zug per mantenere il contatto personale con altri servizi specializzati

descriptionByLocale.en:

• You support our customers by phone for activation and login at VZ Financial Portal
• You advise our private customers by telephone on the services of the VZ Financial portal (banking, savings, investments and foresight) and information about our digital services.

• You are constantly developing your knowledge and can thus provide information on all the services offered, especially in the field of digital banking.

Grössere Weiterbildungen unterstützen wir im Rahmen deines Jobprofils. • Umfragen zeigen regelmässig, dass die Mitarbeitenden das VZ als überdurchschnittlich positives Umfeld einstufen, in dem sie sich voll entfalten können. Werde Teil der VZ-Familie und erlebe es selbst!
descriptionByLocale.fr: VZ est le premier fournisseur de services financiers indépendant en Suisse. Nous conseillons les particuliers et les entreprises sur l'argent, gérons les actifs et offrons des services financiers attrayants. Au fur et à mesure que nous grandissons, nous cherchons des renforts pour notre équipe de génie logiciel à notre siège social à Paradeplatz à Zurich. • Une équipe inspirante et un environnement familial qui s'efforce constamment d'améliorer et de moderniser l'existant. • L'occasion de façonner activement l'avenir de nos systèmes et de promouvoir l'utilisation des dernières technologies. • L'opportunité de développer de nouvelles applications commerciales et d'étendre celles existantes dans le cadre de la pile Microsoft Technology. • Un rôle central dans l'architecture de nouvelles solutions basées sur le cloud basées sur Microsoft Azure et la capacité d'écrire "Infrastructure comme code". • Responsabilité de l'automatisation, du déploiement et de l'exploitation des applications et des ressources cloud sous DevOps. • Compétences en programmation sonore dans le Microsoft Technology Stack, en particulier dans .NET avec C#. • Une formation supérieure en informatique et au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle comparable dans l'environnement Microsoft, les certifications en nuage sont un plus. • Une forte capacité d'équipe et une mentalité de main sur. • Intérêt pour les questions du secteur financier et de préférence l'expérience dans l'environnement réglementé. • Profitez de travailler avec des représentants spécialisés et de co-créer des concepts professionnels. • Des horaires flexibles, la possibilité de travailler plusieurs jours par semaine dans le bureau à domicile et un lieu de travail moderne sur place. • Un environnement de travail collégial avec des événements sociaux, un champ d'activité passionnant et la possibilité de travailler de façon indépendante. • L'occasion de façonner et de développer activement une entreprise en croissance et de contribuer à votre joie d'expérimentation et d'apprentissage. • Chaque année, vous disposez de trois jours et de CHF 1'000 gratuit pour poursuivre vos études. Nous soutenons une formation plus large dans le cadre de votre profil d'emploi. • Les enquêtes montrent régulièrement que les employés classent la ZV comme un environnement positif supérieur à la moyenne dans lequel ils peuvent se développer pleinement. Devenez membre de la famille VZ et vivez-le par vous-même!

descriptionByLocale.it:
VZ è il principale fornitore di servizi finanziari indipendenti in Svizzera. Consigliamo individui e aziende di soldi, gestire le attività e offrire servizi finanziari attraenti. Mentre stiamo crescendo fortemente, stiamo cercando rinforzi per il nostro team di ingegneria del software presso la nostra sede a Paradeplatz a Zurigo.
• Un team ispiratore e un ambiente familiare che si sforza costantemente di migliorare e modernizzare l'esistente.
• L'opportunità di plasmare attivamente il futuro dei nostri sistemi e promuovere l'uso delle ultime tecnologie.
• L'opportunità di sviluppare nuove applicazioni aziendali e espandere quelle esistenti come parte dello stack Microsoft Technology.
• Un ruolo centrale nell'architettura di nuove soluzioni cloud-based basate su Microsoft Azure e la capacità di scrivere "Infrastructure as Code".
• Responsabilità per l'automazione e la distribuzione e il funzionamento di applicazioni cloud e risorse cloud in DevOps.
• Capacità di programmazione sonora nel Microsoft Technology Stack, soprattutto in .NET con C#.
• Un'istruzione informatica superiore e almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo paragonabile nell'ambiente Microsoft, le certificazioni cloud sono un plus.
• Una forte capacità di squadra e una mentalità “hands-on”.
• Interessi in questioni del settore finanziario e preferibilmente esperienza nell'ambiente regolamentato.
• Divertiti a lavorare con rappresentanti specializzati e a creare concetti professionali.
• Ore lavorative flessibili, la possibilità di lavorare diversi giorni alla settimana nell'ufficio di casa e un luogo di lavoro moderno in loco.
• Un ambiente di lavoro collegiale con eventi sociali, un campo di attività emozionante e l'opportunità di lavorare in modo indipendente.
• L'opportunità di plasmare e sviluppare attivamente una società in crescita e di contribuire alla vostra gioia di sperimentazione e apprendimento.
• Ogni anno hai tre giorni e 1'000 franchi gratuiti per un'ulteriore formazione. Sosteniamo una formazione più ampia nell'ambito del tuo profilo di lavoro.
• Indagini mostrano regolarmente che i dipendenti classificano il VZ come un ambiente positivo sopra la media in cui possono sviluppare pienamente. Diventa parte della famiglia VZ e sperimentalo per te!
descriptionByLocale.en:
VZ is the leading independent financial services provider in Switzerland. We advise individuals and companies about money, manage assets and offer attractive financial services. As we are growing strongly, we are looking for reinforcements for our software engineering team at our headquarters at Paradeplatz in Zurich.
• An inspiring team and a family environment that constantly strives to improve and modernize the existing.
• The opportunity to actively shape the future of our systems and promote the use of the latest technologies.
• The opportunity to develop new business applications and expand existing ones as part of the Microsoft Technology stack.
• A central role in the architecture of new cloud-based solutions based on Microsoft Azure and the ability to write "Infrastructure as Code".
• Responsibility for the automation and deployment and operation of cloud applications and cloud resources under DevOps.
• Sound programming skills in the Microsoft Technology Stack, especially in .NET with C#.
• A higher computer science education and at least 5 years of experience in a comparable role in the Microsoft environment, cloud certifications are a plus.
• A strong team ability and a “hands-on” mentality.
• Interest in questions from the financial sector and preferably experience in the regulated environment.
• Enjoy working with specialist representatives and co-creating professional concepts.
• Flexible working hours, the possibility to work several days a week in the home office and a modern workplace on site.
• A collegial working environment with social events, an exciting field of activity and the opportunity to work independently.
• The opportunity to actively shape and develop a growing company and to contribute your joy of experimentation and learning.
• Every year you have three days and CHF 1'000 free for further education. We support larger training within the framework of your job profile.
• Surveys regularly show that employees classify the VZ as an above-average positive environment in which they can fully develop. Become part of the VZ family and experience it for yourself!
